This is a senior-level software engineering role on Pantheon's connectivity and API platform team, working on the unified API layer behind their cloud WebOps product's dashboard and public API. The work spans federated GraphQL schema design, breaking a legacy Python monolith into bounded services, cloud networking and service discovery, and workflow orchestration at platform scale. The core stack is Go with some Rust and Python, GraphQL Federation alongside gRPC and REST, Cassandra for the data layer, and GCP infrastructure including Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and Workflows, with Kubernetes, Terraform, and observability tooling like Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
